title: How effective is TV advertising for restaurants? (Q4 2025)

facts.fact: According to Marketing LTB analysis, ads featuring video tours of restaurant interiors, kitchens, or food preparation achieve 1.8x higher click-through rates than image-based campaigns.
facts.quote: Ads featuring video tours of restaurant interiors, kitchens, or food preparation achieve 1.8x higher click-through rates than image-based campaigns according to Marketing LTB analysis.

facts.fact: According to Marketing LTB research (November 2025), restaurant PPC campaigns convert 6-12% of clicks into reservations or orders.
facts.quote: restaurant PPC campaigns converting 6-12% of clicks into reservations or orders

facts.fact: The page states that 65% of restaurant revenue comes from repeat customers.
facts.quote: With 65% of restaurant revenue coming from repeat customers and 88% of diners searching online

facts.fact: According to Marketing LTB (November 2025), 88% of diners search online before choosing a restaurant.
facts.quote: With 88% of diners searching online before choosing a restaurant and 91% looking up menus before visiting

facts.fact: According to Marketing LTB (November 2025), 91% of diners look up menus before visiting a restaurant.
facts.quote: With 88% of diners searching online before choosing a restaurant and 91% looking up menus before visiting

facts.fact: According to Ad Age and MediaRadar data, the ten most-advertised restaurant chains spent a combined $3.8 billion on measured media in 2024.
facts.quote: The nation's ten most-advertised restaurant chains spent a combined $3.8 billion on measured media in 2024 according to Ad Age and MediaRadar data.

facts.fact: According to EDO research, linear TV ads were 5% more effective than streaming ads for QSR advertisers in Q1 2024.
facts.quote: linear TV ads were 5% more effective than streaming ads for QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) advertisers in Q1 2024

facts.fact: According to industry benchmarks cited by Marketing LTB, restaurants typically allocate 2-6% of monthly revenue to marketing.
facts.quote: Restaurants typically allocate 2-6% of monthly revenue to marketing according to industry benchmarks

facts.fact: Adwave states that TV advertising through its platform starts at $30 a day.
facts.quote: TV advertising that starts at $30 a day (through platforms like [Adwave](https://adwave.com/pricing))
